name: Build APK

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: JDK 17 o'rnatish
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '17'
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Gradle o'rnatish
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v3
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.5'

      - name: Loyiha fayllarini yaratish
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p app/src/main/java/com/dadam/yordamchi
          mkdir -p app/src/main/assets

          [ -f settings.gradle ] || cat > settings.gradle <<'EOF'
          rootProject.name = "DadamYordamchisi"
          include ':app'
          EOF

          [ -f build.gradle ] || cat > build.gradle <<'EOF'
          buildscript {
              repositories {
                  google()
                  mavenCentral()
              }
              dependencies {
                  classpath 'com.android.tools.build:gradle:8.2.0'
              }
          }
          allprojects {
              repositories {
                  google()
                  mavenCentral()
              }
          }
          EOF

          [ -f gradle.properties ] || cat > gradle.properties <<'EOF'
          android.useAndroidX=true
          android.enableJetifier=true
          org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2048m
          EOF

          [ -f app/build.gradle ] || cat > app/build.gradle <<'EOF'
          plugins {
              id 'com.android.application'
          }
          android {
              namespace 'com.dadam.yordamchi'
              compileSdk 34
              defaultConfig {
                  applicationId "com.dadam.yordamchi"
                  minSdk 21
                  targetSdk 34
                  versionCode 1
                  versionName "1.0"
              }
              buildTypes {
                  release {
                      minifyEnabled false
                  }
              }
          }
          EOF

          [ -f app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml ] || cat > app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml <<'EOF'
          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
          <manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
              <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET" />
              <application
                  android:allowBackup="true"
                  android:label="Dadam Yordamchisi"
                  android:theme="@android:style/Theme.Material.Light.NoActionBar">
                  <activity
                      android:name=".MainActivity"
                      android:exported="true">
                      <intent-filter>
                          <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN" />
                          <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER" />
                      </intent-filter>
                  </activity>
              </application>
          </manifest>
          EOF

          [ -f app/src/main/java/com/dadam/yordamchi/MainActivity.java ] || cat > app/src/main/java/com/dadam/yordamchi/MainActivity.java <<'EOF'
          package com.dadam.yordamchi;

          import android.app.Activity;
          import android.os.Bundle;
          import android.webkit.WebSettings;
          import android.webkit.WebView;
          import android.webkit.WebViewClient;

          public class MainActivity extends Activity {
              private WebView webView;

              @Override
              protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
                  super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
                  webView = new WebView(this);
                  setContentView(webView);
                  WebSettings settings = webView.getSettings();
                  settings.setJavaScriptEnabled(true);
                  settings.setDomStorageEnabled(true);
                  webView.setWebViewClient(new WebViewClient());
                  webView.loadUrl("file:///android_asset/index.html");
              }

              @Override
              public void onBackPressed() {
                  if (webView.canGoBack()) {
                      webView.goBack();
                  } else {
                      super.onBackPressed();
                  }
              }
          }
          EOF

          [ -f app/src/main/assets/index.html ] || cat > app/src/main/assets/index.html <<'EOF'
          <!DOCTYPE html>
          <html lang="uz">
          <head>
          <meta charset="UTF-8">
          <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
          <title>Dadam Yordamchisi</title>
          <style>
              * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
              body {
                  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
                  background: #f0f4f8;
                  display: flex;
                  flex-direction: column;
                  height: 100vh;
              }
              .header {
                  background: #2c7be5;
                  color: white;
                  padding: 20px;
                  text-align: center;
                  font-size: 24px;
                  font-weight: bold;
              }
              .chat-box {
                  flex: 1;
                  overflow-y: auto;
                  padding: 15px;
              }
              .message {
                  margin: 10px 0;
                  padding: 15px;
                  border-radius: 15px;
                  font-size: 20px;
                  max-width: 85%;
                  line-height: 1.4;
                  white-space: pre-wrap;
              }
              .user-msg {
                  background: #2c7be5;
                  color: white;
                  margin-left: auto;
                  border-bottom-right-radius: 3px;
              }
              .bot-msg {
                  background: white;
                  color: #333;
                  border: 2px solid #e0e0e0;
                  border-bottom-left-radius: 3px;
              }
              .input-area {
                  display: flex;
                  padding: 15px;
                  background: white;
                  border-top: 2px solid #e0e0e0;
              }
              #userInput {
                  flex: 1;
                  padding: 15px;
                  font-size: 20px;
                  border: 2px solid #ccc;
                  border-radius: 25px;
                  outline: none;
              }
              #sendBtn {
                  margin-left: 10px;
                  padding: 15px 25px;
                  font-size: 20px;
                  background: #2c7be5;
                  color: white;
                  border: none;
                  border-radius: 25px;
              }
              .loading {
                  text-align: center;
                  color: #999;
                  font-size: 18px;
                  padding: 10px;
              }
          </style>
          </head>
          <body>
          <div class="header">🤖 Dadam Yordamchisi</div>
          <div class="chat-box" id="chatBox">
              <div class="message bot-msg">Assalomu alaykum! Savolingizni yozing. 😊</div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-area">
              <input type="text" id="userInput" placeholder="Savolingizni yozing..." />
              <button id="sendBtn" onclick="sendMessage()">Yuborish</button>
          </div>
          <script>
          const API_KEY = "YANGI_GEMINI_API_KEY_SHU_YERGA";
          const chatBox = document.getElementById('chatBox');
          const userInput = document.getElementById('userInput');

          userInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
              if (e.key === 'Enter') sendMessage();
          });

          function addMessage(text, isUser) {
              const div = document.createElement('div');
              div.className = 'message ' + (isUser ? 'user-msg' : 'bot-msg');
              div.innerText = text;
              chatBox.appendChild(div);
              chatBox.scrollTop = chatBox.scrollHeight;
          }

          async function sendMessage() {
              const text = userInput.value.trim();
              if (!text) return;

              if (API_KEY === "YANGI_GEMINI_API_KEY_SHU_YERGA") {
                  addMessage("⚠️ API kalit qo'yilmagan. index.html faylida API_KEY ni o'zgartiring.", false);
                  return;
              }

              addMessage(text, true);
              userInput.value = '';

              const loadingDiv = document.createElement('div');
              loadingDiv.className = 'loading';
              loadingDiv.innerText = 'Yozmoqda...';
              chatBox.appendChild(loadingDiv);
              chatBox.scrollTop = chatBox.scrollHeight;

              try {
                  const response = await fetch(
                      'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.5-flash:generateContent?key=' + API_KEY,
                      {
                          method: 'POST',
                          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                          body: JSON.stringify({
                              systemInstruction: {
                                  parts: [{ text: "Siz foydali, mehribon va sodda tilda javob beruvchi yordamchisiz. Har doim o'zbek tilida, qisqa va tushunarli javob bering." }]
                              },
                              contents: [
                                  { role: "user", parts: [{ text: text }] }
                              ]
                          })
                      }
                  );

                  const data = await response.json();
                  loadingDiv.remove();

                  const answer = data.candidates &&
                                 data.candidates[0] &&
                                 data.candidates[0].content &&
                                 data.candidates[0].content.parts &&
                                 data.candidates[0].content.parts[0] &&
                                 data.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text;

                  if (answer) {
                      addMessage(answer, false);
                  } else {
                      const errMsg = (data.error && data.error.message) ? data.error.message : 'Noma\'lum xatolik';
                      addMessage('Xatolik: ' + errMsg, false);
                  }
              } catch (error) {
                  loadingDiv.remove();
                  addMessage('Internet aloqasini tekshiring.', false);
              }
          }
          </script>
          </body>
          </html>
          EOF

      - name: APK yasash
        run: gradle assembleDebug

      - name: APK yuklash
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dadam-yordamchi-apk
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

      - name: Xabar
        run: |
          echo "✅ APK tayyor!"
          ls -la app/build/outputs/apk/debug/
